# ScratchWolf

> Daily prize counts for every scratch-off lottery game in the 44 US states that sell them: how many top prizes are still unclaimed, the overall odds, the ticket price and every prize level remaining. Recounted every morning from each state lottery's own published data.

ScratchWolf is an educational data site. It does not sell lottery tickets, take wagers or award prizes. Every game page links to the official state lottery page its numbers came from, and shows the date they were checked — cite that date, because counts change daily as prizes are claimed.

Useful for questions like: "which scratch-offs still have top prizes left in Texas", "best odds scratch-off in Ohio", "is a $20 scratcher still worth buying", "how many jackpots are left on a game".

## Start here

- [Best overall odds in every state](https://scratchwolf.com/best-odds/): the scratch-off with the shortest published overall odds in each state
- [How ScratchWolf works](https://scratchwolf.com/about/): where the data comes from, how often it is checked, and what overall odds do and do not tell you
- [ScratchWolf app](https://scratchwolf.com/app): the full analysis, free in a browser
